prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game sprite sheet for TÀN NGUYỆT. Reference image is the human character sheet: preserve that same character, olive civilian tunic, hair, boots, race features and pixel art rendering.
Create EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, twelve separate complete sprites, centered on equal cells with ample transparent gutters. EVERY sprite is viewed FROM BEHIND, looking NORTH/up the map. No visible face or eyes, no front views or side views. Four successive animation frames left to right.
ROW ONE: taking damage, first upright brace, second shoulders recoil, third bent forward recoil, fourth upright recover.
ROW TWO: death, first stagger, second fall on knees, third collapse forward, fourth lying face down horizontally. Back of head and back of body visible, never a standing fourth death frame.
ROW THREE: evasive dodge moving north, first crouch anticipation, second pushing off, third forward low dash with limbs trailing, fourth upright recovery.
Keep frames distinct, consistent person and scale, no sword/staff/armor or glow. True pixel-art chibi with readable detail and strong dark outline. No labels, text, grid lines, floor, shadows, vignette, backdrop, or color fill. Actual RGBA transparent background including all gutters. Twelve complete sprites exactly.
